g.text: Frontier resolution ── warm up-walk vs cold down-walk (T-CACHE: warm == cold)
GOAL — parent_frontier(parent, J), J = just(child) ⊇ just(parent):
the highest main-spine ancestor of `parent` that is finalized over J.
blue (#1565C0) = read query · purple (#6A1B9A) = oracle call (ft_witnessed)
green (#2E7D32) = finalized/ok · orange (#E65100) = advance / stop verdict
gray (#546E7A) = cheap local hop (no oracle) · red (#C62828) = guard trip → fallback
[WARM path — cache hit and both guards hold]
blocks are a downward-closed spine prefix.
[up-walk from pivot toward parent — amortized O(1)]
[COLD path — cache miss / guard trip / off-spine / genesis]
MISS (or a warm guard tripped above)
[top-down from parent down to first finalized (or genesis)]
ft_witnessed(step) ≥ θ ? [one call per step DOWN]
not finalized ⟹ step down · finalized ⟹ STOP
By L-ANC (constant committee) finalized blocks are a DOWNWARD-CLOSED
PREFIX of the spine ⟹ warm result == cold result
the AdjDC premise from the committee-constancy guard). The cache never forks (S1).
